hold_text: Touches scripts/ci/check_manager_scope.py (guard logic that refuses work). The manager merges.
why: BLOCKER (AM-OPS-8, manager brief 2026-11-19 item 1). manager-scope-guard R2 failed lane AM-OPS-7's PRs #27299, #27308 and #27313 as manager commits. ROOT CAUSE, measured over every commit reachable from all 2,285 remote branches: AM-OPS-7 ran a work-store export dry run (scripts/ops/work.py export --to-files) on branch am-ops-7/work-export, commit 496dfe54de. The export re-emitted 87 row lanes that name OTHER sessions; dispatch_observations read those added lane lines as AM-OPS-7 dispatching, admitted it to the roster with a 24h window, and R2 graded its ops-tooling, test and deploy commits as a manager's. Since the WSD-S4 freeze (#23962, 2026-11-07) row writes go to work_store.db and the row files are an EXPORT, so a lane line in an export commit was written by the store's writer, never by the exporter. That export was the ONLY post-freeze commit the reader counted as a dispatch. FIX (identity source, no exception entry, no trailer change): is_export_commit() treats a commit whose tree OR any parent's tree carries _header.json frozen_into_work_store as an export; its lane lines are not dispatch evidence, in both the fast reader and the exact one behind --verify-dispatch. The parent half covers the --unfreeze rollback export. An unparseable header is counted out loud and NOT treated as an export. LIVENESS: the dispatch source now reports export_only at a frozen HEAD instead of claiming live, and every run prints that R2 cannot see a manager who started after the freeze. That loss already existed: no real dispatch has appeared in git since 2026-11-07, and the current manager is not on the roster. It is reported, not failed, on the same grounds rule_liveness already uses for R6/R7/R8 (an operator-approved cutover retired the subject, and failing every PR would red-wall the fleet). The fix that restores a live source is filed as row MANAGER-SCOPE-STORE-IDENTITY (the store's events log names who set each lane). TESTS: self-test 44 cases (3 new: the exact lane-export case, the --unfreeze export, and a control showing a pre-freeze row-file dispatch still admits its manager and still FAILS R2). tests/test_manager_scope_export_commits.py has 5 tests, including one that monkeypatches the old reader and reproduces the CI violation on the same fixture, and one pinning FROZEN_KEY to work_read. REPLAY on full history with all branches: #27308 and #27313 went from violation to no_manager_commits, and so did #27299 under main's guard; exit 0, AM-OPS-7 named and not admitted. No trader file touched. Revert: git revert. Gates this adds or changes: none (this loosens a false positive and adds no gate).
